title: Mixed Event — Get Fit & Fly! Muscle Training! — Episode1 Focus on the Now

meta.Event Outline: Haruka thinks of ways to make exercise fun for MORE MORE JUMP!'s fans. By chance, she meets Tsukasa, who invites her to the athletic event Shinobi Battle!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I can't get what's been happening out of my head.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Why is it that we haven't received a single offer since performing at Idol Lovers?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (The crowd there that day responded so well, and so did everyone on social media...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(It felt like a solid performance...
Even if we didn't end up receiving more offers, it's hard to see why we would get less.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Can I help you? Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I feel like you've had a lot on your mind lately. I came to see how you were doing.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm sorry for making you worry.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Are you bothered by how you haven't been receiving any offers?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Saito's been looking into that for us, so I need to stay focused on the work in front of me. But my mind keeps wandering back to it...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Yes, I understand your concern...
You were receiving more and more offers, and they just suddenly stopped.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I know you're worried, but it's also not good to dwell.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <We don't know what's actually going on, but I do know that you and the others have been doing everything you can for your fans up until now.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Your performances and activities are proof of that. I have to think that you've been making a positive impact on others.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <So, for now, just keep on moving forward, one step at a time.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (There's no point in me worrying like this.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Right now, I should be focusing on spreading as much hope as I can to our fans and giving what's in front of me my best effort.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: For now, I'll try to focus all my attention on this run.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Yes, that's what I like to hear.
I believe in you, Haruka!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I feel much better now after talking to MEIKO, so I'll keep running and...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(Oh, I know.
I might take this opportunity to up my distance a little. Running a new route should help take my mind off what's been happening.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Choosing this path was a good idea.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (There's plenty of greenery, and the air tastes so fresh. Plus, this sidewalk's easy to run on because it's so nice and wide.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Maybe I'll run this route again sometime...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Good morning.
It's been a while.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Can I ask what you two are doing?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I was doing my morning run, and just so happened to bump into Akito doing the same!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We were catching up, and enjoying some sparkling conversation!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, Kiritani, were you also running just now?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, as a part of my daily routine.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I don't usually run around here, but I decided to try someplace new and go a little further than normal, since I had a little time.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, what wonderful work ethic!
We should expect no less from a professional idol!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As a future star, I need to do the same! Let's follow Kiritani's example and run as much as we can today!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, it's not good to just run until you drop.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But singing and dancing does require a lot of stamina. In that sense, I guess it's important to train hard every day.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
That's exactly my point!
The more stamina you have, the better your practices become!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. I agree.
Let's all do our best.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, anyway... I need to get back to my run. I'd also like to change before I head to school.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Okay, see you at school!
Take care, Kiritani!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (They're all doing what they can to make their dreams come true.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Which means I need to do the same!)
